FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING | JOB DESCRIPTION
Forward Deployed Engineer I
About Sayari
Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.
The Role
Sayari’s customers run risk screening, graph analytics and investigation workflows, and data integrations (APIs and feeds) on the Commercial World Model. Those deployments have to work on day one and keep working. As a Forward Deployed Engineer I, you own that outcome. You scope the problem with the customer, prove it technically, ship it, and keep the account healthy after go-live. The same engineer scopes the work and delivers it.
This is not a ticket queue. You receive direction, not a script. You work across a portfolio of accounts rather than embedding in one, so the role rewards engineers who move fast, document as they go, and leave every deployment in a state another engineer can pick up. Opportunity to contribute to Sayari’s agentic platform.
What You’ll Do
Scope and prove: run technical scoping and evaluation with customer teams, and confirm Sayari fits the workflow before delivery starts.
Implement: deploy risk screening, graph analytics and investigation workflows, and data integrations (APIs and feeds). Write production Python and SQL to do it.
Deliver data: execute bulk data cuts and formatted data products (Parquet, CSV), set up and support API endpoints, and onboard customer pipelines: environment setup, data validation, integration testing.
Keep deployments healthy: monitor usage and pipeline status, build dashboards that give customers and internal teams clear visibility, and resolve issues before they become churn risk.
Build the playbook: follow and improve delivery playbooks and SOPs. Document your work clearly enough that another engineer can pick it up without a handoff call.
Feed the product: bring recurring customer needs and field findings back to core engineering.
What We’re Looking For
Required
3 to 5 years in a client-facing technical role (forward deployed engineering, sales engineering, technical delivery, or technical consulting).
Production Python, including the data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas).
Deep SQL: writing and optimizing complex queries.
Hands-on experience integrating, testing, and supporting REST APIs.
Large-scale data processing with Spark, BigQuery, or Snowflake, and pipeline orchestration with Airflow or similar.
Working knowledge of AWS or GCP.
AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude, or similar) as a daily part of how you work.
Strong written and verbal communication. You explain technical work clearly to engineers, analysts, and senior stakeholders.
Problem solving in ambiguity, and fast uptake of new technologies and tools.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field.
Desired
Building with LLM APIs for analytical or automation tasks.
Containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud deployment patterns.
BI and dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase).
Graph data technologies and their query languages.
Exposure to ML, NLP, or entity resolution.
Experience in high-stakes domains: AML and financial crime, supply chain risk, or national security.
How You Work
You are self-directed. You do not need someone to define every step. You spot gaps, ask the right questions, flag tradeoffs, and execute. You hold a high bar on output quality because the work you hand off represents Sayari to the customer. You take full accountability for what you deliver.
Logistics
Travel and in-office time: 25-30% combined.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. ROLE IMPACT

Build the data behind Prime Intellect’s next generation of open models. You’ll find valuable sources, turn them into training-ready corpora, and work with researchers to test what actually improves the model. Your work will shape both broad pre-training and the data used to develop reasoning, coding, and long-context capabilities.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Find, evaluate, and collect valuable training data from web, code, and technical sources.

 - Build scalable pipelines that turn raw data into training-ready corpora through extraction, cleaning, deduplication, and filtering.

 - Develop checks for data quality, coverage, and contamination, and use them to improve collection and processing.

 - Work with researchers on data mixtures and sampling strategies for pre-training and midtraining.

 - Prepare and evaluate data for long-context learning, reasoning, and coding, testing synthetic data where it proves useful.

 - Run controlled data experiments and use model evaluations to decide which sources, mixtures, and processing choices are worth scaling.

 - Make large-scale data processing efficient, reproducible, and recoverable, with clear source provenance and dataset versioning.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong programming skills in Python and a record of building reliable data-processing or distributed systems.

 - Experience working with large datasets and managing the practical tradeoffs of storage, compute, throughput, and reproducibility.

 - Ability to diagnose data-quality issues and translate research goals into measurable checks and experiments.

 - Comfort owning an evolving technical problem end to end and working closely with researchers to test assumptions and improve the system.

Relevant experience may include:

 - Web crawling, document extraction, code-data collection, or large-scale corpus curation.

 - Deduplication, text classification, quality scoring, synthetic data, or training-data contamination analysis.

 - Data-mixture experiments, curriculum learning, or measuring how dataset changes affect model performance.

Nice to have

 - Experience preparing datasets for language-model pre-training, continued pre-training, or midtraining.

 - Work with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or comparable systems.

 - Experience with multilingual, mathematical, scientific, or repository-level code data.

 - Familiarity with tokenization, training data loaders, and the needs of large model-training runs.

Depth in data acquisition, scalable processing, or data research can be a strong starting point. We don’t expect every candidate to have worked across all of them.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Cash Compensation Range of $150-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect.

 - Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in-person at our offices in San Francisco.

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates.

 - Quarterly team off-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities.

 - Opportunity to work with a talented, hard-working and mission-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.
